## What's Changed
* feat: detect multiple Claude Code directories by @muness in https://github.com/open-horizon-labs/bottle/pull/54


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/open-horizon-labs/bottle/compare/v0.3.1...v0.3.2

## What's Changed
* docs: clarify bespoke bottles and example-team documentation by @muness in https://github.com/open-horizon-labs/bottle/pull/51
* feat: add npm publishing for opencode plugin by @muness in https://github.com/open-horizon-labs/bottle/pull/53


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/open-horizon-labs/bottle/compare/v0.3.0...v0.3.1

## What's Changed
* Add proper OpenCode skills support by @muness in https://github.com/open-horizon-labs/bottle/pull/44
* docs: add team setup pattern for bespoke bottles by @muness in https://github.com/open-horizon-labs/bottle/pull/45
* fix: auto-bump Cargo.toml version to match release tag by @muness in https://github.com/open-horizon-labs/bottle/pull/47
* feat: refactor release workflow with plan pattern by @muness in https://github.com/open-horizon-labs/bottle/pull/49
* feat: add Linux binaries using cargo-zigbuild by @muness in https://github.com/open-horizon-labs/bottle/pull/50


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/open-horizon-labs/bottle/compare/v0.2.2...v0.3.0

## What's Changed

- **`bottle update` now refreshes platform integrations** - Automatically updates Claude Code plugins, OpenCode configs, and Codex skills during `bottle update`
- Updates run even when tools are current (plugins/skills may have independent updates)
- Non-fatal warnings for per-platform failures

## Install

```sh
brew install open-horizon-labs/tap/bottle
```

Or update existing installation:
```sh
brew upgrade bottle
```

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/open-horizon-labs/bottle/compare/v0.2.1...v0.2.2

## What's Changed

- **wm dive-prep skill registration** - `/wm:dive-prep` now properly invokes the Task agent instead of falling back to CLI
- **Plugin sync** - Updated wm plugin to 0.3.3 with skills/ directory
- **Docs** - Added development workflow to AGENTS.md

## Install

```sh
brew install open-horizon-labs/tap/bottle
```

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/open-horizon-labs/bottle/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1
